dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Oh, good morning! Wait, is it morning? ... Anyway, good day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About my reputation with the People of the Springs...

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Oh, yes, thank you so much for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello. What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: This is an Obsidian Totem Pole. Pretty awesome, huh? They say you can directly connect to the Wayob here!

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: It's just that sorta sacred relic... although the details escape me. Haha, that's what you get when you've never been good at history.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: If there's anything more you'd like to know, feel free to consult the person on the night shift!

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, so long as you're willing to help us People of the Springs a little, the Totem Pole won't do you dirty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good day.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Hello, hello! Sorry, but I can't chat for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Now I'm not an introvert, but working hours are as they are, and getting caught slacking off could go badly for me.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: What work am I doing, you ask? Why, shift duty! And how will I do that? ... Well, by being here, am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: See you after I get off work tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Ah, the night breeze, too, is a part of the music.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good evening.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Hey there! If you wanna ask about the Obsidian Totem Pole, it's best you look for Kahuna. I'm off work right now.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: If you want to listen to some music with me, feel free! An extra companion wouldn't hurt!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Caramuru
dialogues.text: Not going to listen for a while longer?
